newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's foreign investment rose 13 pct in 9-mo.
newsitem.headline: Spain's foreign investment rose 13 pct in 9-mo.

text.p: Spanish direct investment abroad rose 13 percent in the first nine months of 1996 to 757 billion pesetas, data from the Economy Ministry showed on Tuesday.
Non-European OECD countries ranked highest amongst recipients, with 348.46 billion pesetas or 46.01 percent of the total.
Latin America ranked second, receiving 307 billion pesetas, or 40.54 percent of Spain's total foreign investment.
The European Union was the third biggest recipient with 276 billion pesetas, or 36.46 percent of the total.
